verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents a Machines REST API and publishes an OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer or runnable examples. A machine-readable spec is a building block that could power such a reference, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://fly.io/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
The Fly Machines REST API provides resources to provision and manage Fly Apps, Fly Machines, and Fly Volumes.
